title: 🏠 Robots Build Homes in a Factory — Reframe Cuts Build Time and Lowers the Cost!
body: 🏠 Robots Build Homes in a Factory — Reframe Cuts Build Time and Lowers the Cost!

Massachusetts robotics company Reframe Systems has developed an AI-powered platform that automates the design and production of home components in a factory, in an attempt to tackle the housing shortage and a tight labour market.

The robots manufacture building elements inside the factory, which workers then assemble at the construction site; by moving most of the work into the factory, the company aims to cut building costs and shorten build times, instead of building everything outdoors under changing weather and delayed schedules.

The idea is not entirely new, but what is new is that AI runs design and production together, taking into account from the start what robots can manufacture precisely and quickly, instead of designing a traditional house and then trying to automate its construction afterwards.
Simply put: your next home may mostly be made in a factory by robots, then assembled at your site within days; would you live in a home built by robots, or do you prefer traditional construction?
Would you live in a home made in a factory by robots, or does traditional building feel safer to you?
